definitions.explanation: A sweet crystalline substance obtained from sugarcane or sugar beets, used as a sweetener in food and drinks.

examples.english: Do you put sugar in your coffee?

notes:
{砂糖|さとう} is sugar, one of the basic cooking ingredients in Japanese cuisine.

TYPES OF SUGAR:
- ⟦{白|しろ}{砂糖|さとう}→白砂糖：26404_shirozatou⟧: white sugar
- ⟦{黒|くろ}{砂糖|さとう}→黒砂糖：18292_kurozatou⟧: brown sugar/muscovado
- ⟦グラニュー{糖|とう}→グラニュー糖：23996_guranyuutou⟧: granulated sugar
- ⟦{角砂糖|かくざとう}→角砂糖：18293_kakuzatou⟧: sugar cube

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {砂糖|さとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to add sugar
- {砂糖|さとう}⟦{抜|ぬ}き→抜き：23505_nuki⟧: without sugar, sugar-free
- {砂糖|さとう}⟦{控|ひか}えめ→控えめ：17234_hikaeme⟧: low sugar

IN COOKING:
Unlike Western cooking, Japanese cuisine uses sugar in many savory dishes (⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧, teriyaki, etc.).

WATCH OUT:
{砂糖|さとう} and ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt) look similar - a common mix-up in the kitchen!

USAGE:
⟦{佐藤|さとう}→佐藤：27597_satou⟧ (same pronunciation) is one of the most common Japanese surnames.
